product.name: Swan Valley Wine Tours
product.shortDescription:
Swan Valley Wine Tour: Your Perfect Wine Escape
30min from Perth.
3 premium tastings, gourmet lunch, sweet treats.
Local guide, door-to-door service.
Your music, your vibe.
Pure wine adventure, zero tourists traps.
product.description:
:

? Welcome, Wine Lovers — Your Swan Valley Escape Awaits!

Unwind Tours presents: The Swan Valley Wine Tour Not just a ride. Not just a tour. This is your all-access pass to Western Australia’s most charming wine region—led by a local guide who knows every hidden gem, every vintage worth sipping, and every bite worth tasting.

Imagine boutique family-run wineries that’ll leave you speechless, gourmet food that dances on your palate, and vineyard views that’ll make your Instagram pop. This isn’t your average wine tour—it’s a full-bodied experience.

? What’s Included

  • ?️ Gourmet Lunch Indulge in a chef-prepared meal at one of Swan Valley’s top wineries, paired with a glass of their finest.

  • ? Premium Wine Tastings Enjoy three curated tastings at standout venues like Lancaster, Nikola Estate, and Sittella (subject to availability).

  • ? Sweet Non-Alcoholic Stop From artisan chocolate to the House of Honey, we’ll tailor a treat stop just for you.

  • ? Hassle-Free Pick-Up & Drop-Off We’ll pick you up, drop you off, and handle the logistics so you can focus on relaxing.

  • ? Your Playlist, Your Vibe With our Bluetooth speaker onboard, you’re the DJ of your own adventure.

  • ? Local Guide, Not Just a Driver Get insider stories, local tips, and a warm, friendly guide who makes the day unforgettable.

? Group Perks

  • ? Exclusive Gift for Groups Groups of 10+ receive a complimentary bottle of wine with a custom label from Tylers Vineyard—only available on our Swan Valley tours.

  • ? Private Group Tours Available Planning a birthday, hens party, or corporate outing? We’ll tailor the day to your crew.

? Call Paul directly to book: 0478 700 085

? Optional Add-Ons

  • Cheese Board – $20 Add a gourmet cheese platter to elevate your tasting experience.

  • Gin Tasting – $10 Sample handcrafted gin at one of Swan Valley’s boutique distilleries.

? Pricing

$175 per person Includes gourmet lunch, three premium wine tastings, and all the good vibes.

? Tour Details

  • Departure Time: 10:30 AM (or 10:00 AM if picked up from Fremantle—just let us know!)

  • Pick-Up Locations:

    • Hilton Downtown Perth

    • Crown Casino

    • Swan Valley Visitor Centre

    • Fremantle (on request, no extra charge)

  • Duration: Approximately 7 hours of pure indulgence.

? What to Bring

  • Comfortable walking shoes

  • Sunscreen and a hat

  • Reusable water bottle (we also provide bottled water)

? Why Choose Unwind Tours?

We’re not just tour guides—we’re your local insiders. With deep connections to Swan Valley’s best winemakers, chefs, and artisans, we craft experiences that are relaxed, informative, and unforgettable. Whether you’re a wine connoisseur or just love a good day out, this is the tour you’ll rave about.

? Call Paul: 0478 700 085 ? Email: bookings@unwindtours.com.au ? Unwind Tours Website ? Swan Valley Wine Tours Site

productSeoTags.attrValue:
Discover Perth's Hidden Gem: Swan Valley Wine Tours
Skip the tourist traps – experience the real Swan Valley with a local who knows all the secrets!
Just minutes from Perth, discover a world of family wineries, amazing food, and Instagram-worthy views.
Your Perfect Day Includes:

? Three premium wine tastings at top estates
? Gourmet lunch with paired wine
? Sweet treats stop (chocolate or honey – you choose!)
? Be the DJ with our Bluetooth speaker
? Convenient pick-up & drop-off

Join us for a day of tasting, sipping, and unwinding through Swan Valley's finest spots. With a friendly local guide (not just a driver!), you'll discover hidden gems most tourists never see.
Perfect for wine lovers, friend groups, and anyone ready to escape the city for some serious fun!
